x: No option is right: D.C. Sircar's Indian Epigraphical Glossary explains udranga as the fixed or principal land tax (tax on permanent tenants), paired with uparikara (minor taxes); it is not a toll, salt, water or shop tax. The older app key 'tax on water' has no source support.
source: D.C. Sircar, Indian Epigraphical Glossary p.349 (https://sanskrit-lexicon.uni-koeln.de/scans/IEGScan/IEGScanpdf/pg_349.pdf)
evidence: NextGen Eastern Chalukyas: no mention of udranga
Sircar IEG p.349: udranga = fixed/land tax
